subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should OpenClaw add a LINE-owned user-facing media batching delay, and should it prefer LINE imageSet metadata with a same-sender timing fallback rather than a gateway-wide heuristic?
rationale: The remaining request adds public channel configuration and delayed webhook processing behavior, so the tradeoff between UX, reply-token freshness, and cross-channel scope needs maintainer intent before automation changes code.

options.title: Add LINE-owned batching
options.body: Add an optional LINE plugin config key, batch by imageSet when available and by account/conversation/sender timing only as fallback, then update docs and tests.

options.title: Defer as product choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but require live LINE evidence and maintainer design approval before adding a config surface.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Document that users should rely on existing queue/collect behavior or resend media together, accepting that LINE rapid media remains unbatched.

recommendation.title: Add LINE-owned batching
recommendation.body: Add an optional LINE plugin config key, batch by imageSet when available and by account/conversation/sender timing only as fallback, then update docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent LINE handler/context ownership and plugin-seam work make this the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
